supersedes.why: v1.0 recorded truck_rev 79eaaf36 as the built artifact. That was never true: truck-meshalgo resolved through a [patch] path override to a working tree carrying +1270/-167 uncommitted lines against 79eaaf36, including the dual-parity flood that audit A1 concerns. v1.0 asserted a provenance the build did not have.

retired_numbers.status: NOT COMPARABLE to the v2.0 experimental baseline below (19381 rendered / 4821 lost). Two things differ at once: the truck working tree is unidentified in v1.0, and examples/face_census.rs itself was rewritten (+199 lines changed) between a358d70 and this snapshot, so the two figures may not count the same predicate. The discrepancy is recorded rather than reconciled; do not treat 396 as a regression target.

historical_base_rev.role: historical reference only. Filters triangles by polyline.include(centroid); has no dual-parity flood. NOT the causal baseline for A1 - comparing against it would confound the parity correction with every other change in the 1270-line delta.

experimental_base_rev.role: causal baseline for A1. WIP snapshot, unreviewed, not endorsed, not for merge to master.

resolved_truck_meshalgo.correction: an earlier draft of this manifest said the override was the [patch] table in Cargo.toml, for truck-meshalgo alone. That is wrong twice over. The live mechanism is a `paths = [...]` array in .cargo/config.toml, which takes precedence over [patch]; editing Cargo.toml has no effect while it is present, which is how the error was found. And it redirects NINE crates, not one.
resolved_truck_meshalgo.override_file_self_warning: the file's own comment says the block is 'disabled' and warns that 'a path override is invisible in Cargo.lock and a measurement taken through one is not a measurement of anything that has been pushed'. The block is not commented out. It is live, and every truck crate in every measurement recorded here came through it.
resolved_truck_meshalgo.reproducibility_caveat: the eight non-meshalgo crates are content-identical to 79eaaf36 because ../truck-fork is committed and clean at experimental_base_rev, whose only delta to 79eaaf36 is in meshalgo. The measurements are therefore valid. Reproducing them from a clean clone still requires either removing the paths override and pinning by rev, or reproducing the checkout exactly.
resolved_truck_meshalgo.bit_reproducibility: NOT established, and an earlier line here claimed it was. Rebuilding A1 immediately after the historical detour did reproduce sha256 374c6636b3212232e9ebb524. Rebuilding it again after a `cargo test` cycle that checked out the snapshot branch and back produced 19e704ca7b342a998fbaa98e from identical committed sources. Byte-identity therefore holds across some rebuilds and not others. Behavioural reproducibility does hold: the second binary produced a byte-identical sorted ledger. Compare ledgers, not binaries.

v3_cylinder_band_recovery_baseline.why: Freeze the first reproducible production baseline containing the certified two-bound cylindrical-band recovery. The recovery adds no new atlas cell: it normalizes the malformed source pattern in which exactly two complete essential cylinder parallels are both declared FACE_OUTER_BOUND, but only after the face independently certifies as a CylinderEssentialBand. This version also closes the prior dependency-provenance caveat by pushing the complete truck history, pinning every truck crate to the pushed revision, removing local path patches, and reproducing the census from git-resolved dependencies alone.
v3_cylinder_band_recovery_baseline.relationship_to_v2_blocks: the sibling top-level blocks of this document (supersedes, revisions, build, semantic_environment, tolerance_policy, corpus_models, corpus_coverage_caveat, determinism) are the retained v2.0 record and are deliberately left byte-unchanged. They remain evidence of the v1.0 false-revision claim and of the .cargo/config.toml path-override failure. Nothing in them is retracted here.
v3_cylinder_band_recovery_baseline.prior_measurement_standing: the earlier measurements are not withdrawn and were not false. Their numerical result was valid against the local committed tree they were taken on; what they lacked was clean-clone dependency provenance. This entry records that the same result is now reproduced from the pushed and pinned dependency alone.

measurements.ledger_capture_caveat: stderr must be captured without PowerShell redirection. PowerShell 5.1 wraps redirected native stderr at the console buffer width, which splits FACE records across physical lines and changes the ledger hash. These ledgers were captured through a POSIX shell with 2> redirection; each run emitted 24202 single-line FACE records.

cylinder_band_recovery_enabled.gate_scope: standalone; deliberately NOT nested under TRUCK_FORMAL_RECOVERY, so the delta against the control is this route's own contribution and no other formal route is opened

delta.reconciliation: 1358543 + 13474 = 1372017, and 19716 + 1968 = 21684; the gained triangles are exactly the recovered annuli and no previously rendered face changed

cylinder_band.result_description: validated recovery from a narrowly classified malformed-source pattern
cylinder_band.not_source_conforming: this result is NOT source-conforming and must never be described as such. Every recovered mesh carries SourceConformance::RecoveredFromMalformedSource(TwoOuterBoundsOnCertifiedBand).

source_authority_census.method: raw STEP source read directly: ADVANCED_FACE bound references resolved to their declaring entity type. No geometry, bound order, area, axial height, orientation, vertex count or tessellated coordinate consulted.
source_authority_census.representative_entity: #27124 = ADVANCED_FACE( '', ( #77859, #77860 ), #77861, .F. ); #77859 and #77860 are both FACE_OUTER_BOUND, #77861 is a CYLINDRICAL_SURFACE
source_authority_census.prior_exit_was_a_misreport: the population previously reported as Patch(MissingOuterBoundAuthority). bounded_material_region collapsed every non-unique OuterBoundStanding into the missing-authority exit, so a face stating too much read as one stating nothing. Correcting the report is behaviour-neutral and was the precondition for identifying the real population.

recovery_admission: successful cut-open triangulation, reglue, and annulus validation
admission_rule.normalization: downgrade only the invalid outer-bound qualifiers; preserve loop identity, edge-use identity, traversal, homology, orientation, carrier identity, and source provenance.
admission_rule.enforcement_mechanism: band_material_authority takes a &CertifiedCylinderBand, so the certificate cannot be skipped; cut_open requires the resulting BandMaterialAuthority token. The band reaches the shared material arithmetic through pub(super) bounded_material_region_of, which nothing outside the formal module can call.

v3_cylinder_band_recovery_baseline.reproducibility_caveat: Clean-clone dependency reproducibility is confirmed at the census level: all truck crates resolved from the pushed git revision with no active path or patch override, and the resulting counts were byte-for-byte numerically identical to the earlier local-tree measurement. This entry covers ABC model 00009190 only and is not a corpus-wide completeness claim. Do not claim binary bit-reproducibility unless two clean builds produce the same recorded binary hash.
